Touch it on the reader at the ticket gate when you enter and when you leave; the fare is deducted automatically and is up to ¥18 cheaper than a paper ticket. With RideCard Web you can charge a Personalized RideCard online by credit card (from ¥1,000); the charge is added the next time you touch a ticket gate, at least 30 minutes later. Using RideCard You need a balance of at least ¥170 to enter. If your balance does not cover the fare when you leave, pay the difference at the fare adjustment machine inside the gate. Exit within 3 hours of entering. Otherwise the gate stops you and staff will charge the fare from your entry station. RideCard can be used on Springvale City Bus and Moonview Bus, and in shops inside our stations. It cannot be used on the airport limousine bus. IC cards issued by other railways in Japan cannot be used on Springvale Railway, and RideCard cannot be used outside Harvest Prefecture. The Comet surcharge can be paid from your RideCard balance at reserved-seat ticket machines. If you register a Personalized RideCard when you reserve online , you can board without a paper ticket. RideCard Points With a Personalized RideCard registered on RideCard Web, you earn points when you ride the same section (the same two stations, in either direction) many times in a calendar month: Rides on the same section in the month Points 1st to 10th None 11th to 20th 10% of the fare 21st and later 15% of the fare 1 point = ¥1. Points are added in the middle of the following month and are turned into balance when you touch "Points" on a ticket machine. Sections covered by a commuter pass, 1-Day passes and Comet surcharges do not earn points. Points expire after 12 months. Refunds Return your RideCard at a ticket office: Springvale Central, Castle Town, University Gate (weekdays only), Clayfield, Red Canyon, Moonview Spa, Ferry Port or Rose Garden (Saturdays, Sundays and holidays only). We refund the balance minus a fee of ¥220, plus the ¥500 deposit. If the balance is ¥220 or less, the balance is not refunded but the deposit is. A card with a commuter pass on it is refunded under the commuter pass rules. If you lose a RideCard A Personalized RideCard, Child RideCard, RideCard Commuter or RideCard Assist can be stopped and reissued. Report the loss at a ticket office with ID; the balance is protected from that moment. The new card is ready from 10:00 the next day at the same office, for a reissue fee of ¥520 and a new ¥500 deposit. An unregistered RideCard cannot be reissued. A RideCard that has not been used for 10 years becomes invalid.

What is the cheapest fare? ¥170 with a paper ticket or ¥168 with RideCard, for up to 3 km. See the fare table . Q. Can I use my IC card from Tokyo or Osaka? No. Only RideCard can be used on Springvale Railway. Please buy a paper ticket or a RideCard. Q. Can I pay by credit card? Only at reserved-seat ticket machines (purple) and ticket offices. Regular ticket machines take cash and RideCard only. RideCard itself can be charged by credit card on RideCard Web. Q. How do I get my RideCard deposit back? Return the card at a ticket office. You get the balance minus ¥220 plus the ¥500 deposit. Details . Q. My RideCard balance was not enough when I arrived. What do I do? Use the fare adjustment machine inside the ticket gate, or ask staff. At unstaffed stations, pay on the platform reader or report it at the next staffed station. Q. Is there a pass for one day? Yes: the 1-Day Free Pass, ¥1,300 on weekdays and ¥1,100 on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. Details . Q. I travel the same route a few times a week. What is cheapest? Compare: RideCard fares (cheapest per ride, and RideCard Points from the 11th ride on the same section in a month), the 1-Day Free Pass on days with long return trips, and a commuter pass if you travel most days. A commuter pass usually pays off at around 14 or more round trips a month. Q. Do children need a ticket? Children aged 6–11 pay half fare. Up to two children aged 1–5 travel free with each paying passenger. Details . Q. Can I get a receipt? Ticket machines print a receipt on request (press "Receipt" before paying). For RideCard journeys, print your use history at a ticket machine (last 20 journeys) or on RideCard Web. Q. Is there a student discount? Only on commuter passes. Details . Comet Q. Can I board Comet without a reservation? Yes, if seats are free: buy the surcharge on board for ¥260 extra. Standing is not allowed, so if the train is full you must wait for the next one. Q. When can I reserve? From 10:00 one month before your travel date. Rules . Q. How much does it cost to cancel? ¥340 up to two days before; from the day before, 30% of the surcharge (minimum ¥340). No refund after departure. Details . Q. Which side has the river view? Seat D going north (to Moonview Spa), seat A going south, between Clayfield and Red Canyon. Q. Can I use a 1-Day Free Pass on Comet? Yes, if you also buy the limited express surcharge. Q. Is there a toilet on Comet? Yes, in Cars 2 (multipurpose) and 3. Travelling Q. What time is the last train? See the first and last trains on each timetable page . For example, the last train from Moonview Spa to Springvale Central leaves at 21:40 on weekdays and 21:05 on Saturdays, Sundays and holidays (21:40 every day from 14 November). Q. Why did my train stop at Clayfield? Many Mirror Line locals go only as far as Clayfield. Check the destination: trains for Clayfield are marked "Ka" in the timetables. Q. Can I take my bicycle on the train? Folded or bagged bicycles, yes. Unfolded bicycles only on the Cycle Train (Clayfield–Moonview Spa, weekends and holidays, 10:00–16:00, ¥300). Details . Q. Can I bring my dog? In a carrier (up to 90 cm, 10 kg) with a ¥290 hand luggage ticket. Assistance dogs travel free. Q. Is there Wi-Fi? Free Wi-Fi (ValeRail_Free_WiFi) on Comet and at the stations listed on each station page. Local trains have no Wi-Fi. Q. Do trains have toilets? Mirror Line trains have one in Car 1. Bayside Line trains have none. Q. My train was late. Can I get a delay certificate? Yes, for delays of 5 minutes or more: at the station on the day, or online for the past seven days. Delay certificates . Q. Will the timetable change? Yes, on Saturday 14 November 2026. What changes . Stations and assistance Q. Which stations have coin lockers? Springvale Central, Castle Town, University Gate, Clayfield, Red Canyon, Moonview Spa, Market Square, Rose Garden and Ferry Port. Se

t: About Springvale Railway
x: About Springvale Railway Springvale Railway Co., Ltd. (春川鉄道, "Vale Rail") runs the Mirror Line and the Bayside Line in Springvale City, Harvest Prefecture. Head office 1-1 Station Square, Springvale, Harvest Prefecture 780-0001 Founded 1923 (as Mirror Valley Railway) Lines Mirror Line 38.6 km (14 stations), Bayside Line 16.2 km (9 stations); 22 stations in all Rolling stock 46 cars, including three 3-car Comet trains Employees 684 (April 2026) Passengers About 41 million a year (FY2025); 112,430 boardings a day History 1926 Mirror Valley Railway opens Springvale – Clayfield 1931 Extended to Moonview Spa 1951 Renamed Springvale Railway 1962 Bayside Line opens to Ferry Port 1987 Limited express Comet starts 1998 Bayside Line elevated between Springvale Central and Pier Road 2012 RideCard IC card introduced 2019 New Comet trains with Premium seats Ridership Careers We recruit station staff, drivers and engineers every spring. Applications for April 2027 close on 30 November 2026. Privacy We use personal information given to us (for reservations, lost property and RideCard registration) only for those purposes and do not pass it to third parties except as required by law. This site uses cookies for analytics. About this site This is a fictional website made for research (a user study of the UniLens assistant). Springvale City, Springvale Railway and everything on this site are invented.

The platform 2 lift (southbound, for Springvale Central) is not affected. If you cannot use the stairs To board a northbound train at Castle Town: between 7:00 and 20:00, ask staff at the ticket gate; they will take you to platform 1 by the staff route at the north end of the station. Outside these hours, take a southbound train from platform 2 to Springvale Central (lifts on all platforms) and board your northbound train there. To get off a northbound train at Castle Town: stay on to University Gate (lifts on both platforms), change to a southbound train and come back to Castle Town platform 2. There is no extra fare for these detours. Tell the staff at the ticket gate. We apologise for the inconvenience.
